items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Anyhow it was over there with a 70 piece symphony band with Odetta as star.

ctx.x: Did Tatum know that you didn't read music?

Oh yeah. He didn't read music. Nobody read no music. We had no time for no music. I don't know if Slam could read or not, even. Maybe, I really don't know. I know I didn't. Shit, never crossed my mind to read no music. I have faked it quite a few times. I mean faked it too, I faked it in Germany about 5 years ago or 6 years ago --- This one was with Sonny Payne, we were in Frankfurt not Frankfurt -- right next to Frankfurt... Anyhow it was over there with a 70 piece symphony band with Odetta as star. And 5 bass…

About 5 of 'em. Now me like I said, looked like Greek to me. Although this was about six years ago, I could read fairly good, but this was out of sight. So I didn't say anything, I just listened. And they rehearsed all day, for the next day, and by the time they were ready to go to work the next day I had mine, just by listening. I knew exactly what to do -- my little interlude and whatnot. (haha) But this couldn't touch Art Tatum or Slam, they couldn't touch 'em. Those guys, you could blow an automobile horn or…
